body:
Three months, summer to fall of 2008 — that's the whole Joe Jonas chapter, start to finish. Short as it was, it still handed Fearless 'Forever & Always' and a story Taylor kept revisiting for years. Live now in Blank Spaces →

altText: Taylor Swift performing the Fearless set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a gold fringed dress, guitar in hand.
why: X sibling of the 09-24 Blank Spaces timeline beat. Number hook = the duration (three months), deliberately a DIFFERENT number from the IG sibling's lead (27 seconds), with near-disjoint vocabulary — this run's first X draft was rewritten after check-drafts flagged it 89% similar to the IG (the short number-led X was a word-subset of the long IG narrative); it now drops the 27-second/Ellen/record cluster entirely so it clears the <80% cross-post-copy gate. Confirmed-only, blocklist-safe (see IG why). All claims sourced to relationships.mjs:17-37 (rel-jonas, Jul-Oct 2008, 'Forever & Always' confirmed link) and debut.mjs:786-808. Media: fearless-inglewood-2023 (era-right — the post is about Fearless; last used 09-18, the least-recently-used tile alongside debut), distinct from the IG sibling's debut photo per L001. NOTE: the calendar's 'X is text-only' plan for this fortnight is a planning bug — check-drafts.mjs (media rule, 2026-09-10) hard-fails a text-only X draft, so every recently-shipped X post (09-17/09-20/09-22) actually carried a photo; flagged in the PR body for the Monday replan. photoEra unset (cross-era chapter, timeline not a THEMED_CAMPAIGN_PREFIX), consistent with 09-17's fearless X tile.

critique.rationale: The weekly Blank Spaces timeline reaches Joe Jonas, 2008: three months, summer to fall, that still gave Fearless 'Forever & Always.' Duration-number hook, distinct vocabulary from the IG sibling, confirmed-only and sourced to relationships.mjs + debut.mjs. Era-right Fearless photo.
